def fizz_buzz(n: int):
    """Return the number of times the digit 7 appears in integers less than n which are divisible by 11 or 13.
    >>> fizz_buzz(50)
    0
    >>> fizz_buzz(78)
    2
    >>> fizz_buzz(79)
    3
    """
    count = 0
    for i in range(n):
        if (i % 11 == 0) or (i % 13 == 0):
            s = str(i)
            count += s.count('7')
    return count
raw_source:
def fizz_buzz(n: int):
    """Return the number of times the digit 7 appears in integers less than n which are divisible by 11 or 13.
    >>> fizz_buzz(50)
    0
    >>> fizz_buzz(78)
    2
    >>> fizz_buzz(79)
    3
    """
    count = 0
    for i in range(n):
        if (i % 11 == 0) or (i % 13 == 0):
            s = str(i)
            count += s.count('7')
    return count
